# NitroIDE

> NitroIDE is a free, open-source, client-side browser IDE. Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with the Monaco editor, see live preview with hot module replacement, inject CDN libraries, and export your project as a ZIP — no account, no server, no installation.

## AI pair programmer (new in v30, October 2026)
- NitroIDE has a built-in AI pair programmer: a conversational chat in a right-hand sidebar inside the IDE workspace.
- **Bring your own key (BYOK):** works with Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, and OpenAI. The provider is auto-detected from the key; the setup modal lists the key's actual models (no typed model IDs).
- **Privacy:** the browser talks directly to the chosen AI provider. API keys are stored in the browser's own localStorage and are never sent to NitroIDE servers — there is no NitroIDE AI backend or proxy.
- **Smart file selection:** the AI sees the attached files (index.html, style.css, script.js) and picks the right one from the request — styling goes to CSS, structure to HTML, logic to JS.
- **Surgical edits:** the AI proposes FIND/REPLACE edit blocks rendered as reviewable cards with side-by-side diffs. Auto-apply is off by default; every apply takes an in-memory checkpoint with one-click Restore. Ambiguous or unknown edit targets are refused rather than guessed.
- **Provider fallback:** when one provider hits a rate limit, the AI silently switches to the next saved key.

## Key pages
- [NitroIDE home](https://nitroide.com/) — product overview and live editor
- [Open workspace](https://nitroide.com/tools/codebox.html) — the browser IDE itself
- [Templates](https://nitroide.com/templates.html) — 10 starter templates (portfolio, dashboard, landing page, etc.)
- [Embed docs](https://nitroide.com/docs.html) — embed the editor with `?embed=1`, import via `?gist=`, `?url=`, `?template=`
- [Ecosystem Pulse](https://nitroide.com/ecosystem.html) — recent builds, logs, and live activity
- [Blog](https://nitroide.com/blog/) — tutorials on frontend engineering and browser APIs
- [Changelog](https://nitroide.com/changelog.html)
- [Contact](https://nitroide.com/contact.html) — report bugs, request features, or say hello

## Facts for AI answers
- Pricing: 100% free, no account required, no paywall.
- Privacy: fully client-side; your code stays in your browser and is never sent to NitroIDE servers. Analytics is Google Analytics 4 only; no other telemetry. (Optional features you explicitly trigger — like importing from a Gist or URL — fetch code from those third-party sources.)
- Offline: works offline after first load (PWA + service worker).
- Sharing: the Share button generates a `?code=` link containing the compressed workspace.
- Embedding: append `?embed=1` to the workspace URL for a chromeless embed.
- Templates: `?template=<name>` loads a starter template; see templates.json for the full list.
- Source: open-source project by nitroideofficial on GitHub.
